scope: Initial concrete regression mapping; partial AUTH coverage only. All other family obligations remain open.

cases: Cryptographically validate ordinary token identity and absence of admin role
Cryptographically validate explicit admin role and identity
Reject an ordinary token under a different signing key
Reject an ordinary token under a different audience
Default access-token expiry is sixty minutes
backend.limits: Does not test middleware, cookies, account state, refresh, revoked tokens or administrator endpoint policy. Existing JWT/circuit-breaker tests are additional baseline checks.

cases: Anonymous request has no bearer header
Current stored token attached to local API request
Body/method/idempotency header preserved and original request unchanged
Removed token is not reused on the next request
frontend.limits: Origin restriction and HTTP error recovery are not covered by these passing tests.
Standalone guard only: does not prove guards are wired to routes. Expired/malformed JWT and SSR policy remain unverified.
